scripts.build:worker: bun build src/worker/index.ts --outfile dist/worker.js --target node --format esm --external corestore --external autobase --external hyperswarm --external hyperbee --external protomux --external compact-encoding
scripts.build: bun run build:worker && bun run build:web
scripts.start: bun run build:worker && bun run build:web && bun src/host/launcher.ts
scripts.start:peer: bun run build:worker && PEER_ID=${PEER_ID:-2} bun src/host/index.ts
